title: D2P Error
description: Protocol-independent error structure returned by D2P implementations (fragment). It is embedded, for example, in a rejected command receipt. Error codes come from a closed registry or are extension names. The 'retryable' value and the informative HTTP status per registered code are listed in the schema catalog (§3.6); the retryable value is not schema-enforced (design decision ADR-019).

error.title: Error
error.description: A single error. Closed object; only 'details' is an open container. Neither 'message' nor 'details' may contain secrets, credentials or raw personal measurement values.

code.description: Machine-readable error code from the registry, or an extension name.

message.description: Human-readable explanation of the error. Not intended for machine processing. MUST NOT contain secrets or raw personal measurement values.

correlationId.description: Correlation ID of the request or command that caused the error, so that clients and operators can trace it.

retryable.description: True if repeating the identical request may succeed later without any change by the client (for example after rate limiting or a temporary outage). For registered codes the value is fixed by the error-code registry.

details.description: Open container for additional, code-specific information. It MAY hold 'diagnostics'. It MUST NOT hold secrets, credentials or raw personal measurement values.

diagnostics.description: Diagnostics that explain the error (for example schema violations behind 'schema_violation').

validationReportRef.description: Reference to the validation report that caused the error (typically with 'validation_failed' or 'gate_denied').

errorCode.title: Error code
errorCode.description: Error code. The 'd2p' registry values match ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$ and form a closed list: invalid_request (400), schema_violation (422), incompatible_schema_version (422), unsupported_capability (422), validation_failed (422), gate_denied (422), unauthenticated (401), forbidden (403), not_found (404), stale_revision (409), conflict (409), idempotency_key_reused (409) are not retryable; rate_limited (429), unavailable (503) and internal (500) are retryable. HTTP statuses are informative. Implementations MAY use extension names for codes outside the registry.

anyOf.description: Extension-defined error code (qualified with a reverse-DNS extension namespace).
